home.title: Every Love Story Deserves a Beautiful Beginning
home.aboutLead:
Wedding Berries was founded by Nazmus Shams and Afsana Rahman, who spent years being the friends everyone asked to help plan their weddings — the ones who ended up managing the caterer, the stage design and the seating chart, unofficially, at every family event.

What started as favors turned into a proper studio. Today we run full-scale weddings, Holud evenings, Akth and Nikah ceremonies, birthday celebrations and destination weddings for clients across Dhaka, Cox's Bazar and beyond — including our first international event, a boat celebration in the Gulf of Thailand.

We keep our client roster deliberately small each season, so every event gets the same level of attention the first one did.

— Shams & Afsana Rahman, Founders

about.title: Our story
about.lead:
We don't just plan events. We build the stage for the most important moments of your life 
— and treat every one with the same devotion, whether it's fifty guests or five hundred.

principles.title: One planner, start to finish
principles.text: You get a single lead planner for the entire process — not a rotating cast handed off between departments.

principles.title: Ceremony-literate planning
principles.text: We know the order of a Gaye Holud, the flow of a Nikah and where a borrowed Western format doesn't quite fit — and plan accordingly.

principles.title: A vendor network built over years
principles.text: Florists, caterers, photographers and venues across Dhaka and Cox's Bazar that we've worked with — and trust — repeatedly.

principles.title: Transparent, itemised budgets
principles.text: You see exactly what each vendor and service costs. No bundled mark-ups hidden inside a single "décor" line item.

principles.title: Comfortable with international guests
principles.text: We regularly coordinate travel, permits and logistics for guests flying in from abroad — including our own destination events overseas.

principles.title: A deliberately small roster
principles.text: We take on a limited number of events each season, so no wedding is squeezed between two others in the same weekend.

services.title: Our services
services.lead:
Event management for every kind of celebration.
Full wedding planning, single-ceremony coordination, or day-of management — scoped around what your event actually needs.

process.title: Wedding & Reception Design
process.text: End-to-end wedding and reception planning — venue, stage design, catering, photography and a full day-of timeline, all managed by one lead planner.

process.title: Holud (Gaye Holud)
process.text: The turmeric ceremony, planned with the color, florals and staging it deserves — coordinated outfits, seating design and a run of show that keeps both families comfortable.

process.title: Akth & Nikah Ceremonies
process.text: Nikah and Akth planning built around the ceremony's actual order — seating for both families, catering coordination, and a pace that never feels rushed.

process.title: Destination Weddings
process.text: Beach ceremonies in Cox's Bazar and destinations further afield, with travel, permits and on-the-ground vendor logistics managed from Dhaka to arrival.

process.title: Birthday Celebrations
process.text: Birthday celebrations from a child's first party to a golden anniversary — themed styling, entertainment booking and full-day coordination.

process.title: Full Event Management
process.text: Engagements, bridal showers, anniversaries and corporate socials — for any celebration that needs one calm, capable team running the details.
